name: CCIW Cross Country Championships
where: Warrenville, IL · host Carroll · St. James Farm
headline: CCIW Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: North Central swept the team titles. The men scored 16 points for their 52nd straight CCIW crown, ahead of Carthage (85) and Millikin (93), and took six of the top seven places, led by individual champion BJ Sorg in 24:05.3. The North Central women won with 48 points over Illinois Wesleyan (61) and Elmhurst (74); Elmhurst’s Jessica Solar won the 6K in 22:13.5.
